inspectedProductionInvariants.name: mode2 readonly contract
inspectedProductionInvariants.conclusion: Expected revert length is a distinct encoded uint24 field. Original callback outgoing must be zero before the local variable is reused; valueReg=255 and incoming=0 are required. Length is bounded. Accepted CALL must fail with exact return length; normal return always fails. Readonly subprograms admit mode1/mode2, with readonly propagation.
inspectedProductionInvariants.boundary: Readonly means accepted descendant EVM effects are reverted, not STATICCALL semantics or gas equivalence. Family owns selector and amount decoding.

inspectedProductionInvariants.name: callback isolation/restoration
inspectedProductionInvariants.conclusion: Mode2 saves and restores CALLBACK_TARGET, CALLBACK_HASH and VM_STATE; sentinel target blocks callbacks during the quote. Saved EVM evidence checks the exact callback sender rejection and pending callback continuation without reinstallation.

inspectedProductionInvariants.name: original/mapped recipient binding

Native-input direct rejects refund/under-debit; legacy default/quoted refund behavior remains.
